templates.description: Celebrate the Tamil harvest festival with traditional Kolam, cooking the sweet Pongal in clay pots, and community games.

taskBlueprints.title: Finalize Pongal date and outdoor venue
taskBlueprints.description: Secure a venue with an outdoor space for traditional Pongal cooking.

taskBlueprints.title: Procure clay pots, sugarcane, and turmeric
taskBlueprints.description: Purchase earthen pots, fresh sugarcane stalks, and turmeric plants for decoration.

taskBlueprints.title: Purchase ingredients for Pongal (Sweet/Venn)
taskBlueprints.description: Buy raw rice, jaggery, moong dal, ghee, cashews, and milk.

taskBlueprints.title: Plan Kolam designs and competition
taskBlueprints.description: Outline areas for Kolam (Rangoli) and define rules for the competition.

taskBlueprints.title: Draw traditional Kolams
taskBlueprints.description: Decorate the entrance and cooking area with elaborate rice flour Kolams.

taskBlueprints.title: Set up traditional firewood/gas stove
taskBlueprints.description: Arrange the stove and pots in the ritual area; decorate pots with ginger/turmeric.

taskBlueprints.title: Cook Sweet Pongal (Pongalo Pongal!)
taskBlueprints.description: Boil milk and rice; celebrate when it overflows with the 'Pongalo Pongal' chant.

taskBlueprints.title: Ritual offerings to the Sun God
taskBlueprints.description: Perform prayers and offer Pongal and sugarcane to the Sun.

taskBlueprints.title: Organize traditional sports (Uriadi, etc.)
taskBlueprints.description: Conduct Uriadi (breaking the pot) and other community games.

taskBlueprints.title: Distribute Pongal and serve traditional lunch
taskBlueprints.description: Distribute the prepared Pongal to all guests and serve lunch.

taskBlueprints.title: Clean up venue and store reusable decor
taskBlueprints.description: Clear the cooking area and dispose of organic waste properly.

budgetBlueprints.title: Clay Pots, Turmeric Plants, and Firewood

timelineBlueprints.title: Kolam Unveiling
timelineBlueprints.description: Traditional Kolams completed at the entrance.

timelineBlueprints.title: Pongal Preparation ritual
timelineBlueprints.description: Lighting the stove and starting the cooking process.

timelineBlueprints.title: The Overlow (Pongalo Pongal!)
timelineBlueprints.description: Celebrating the milk boiling over, symbolizing prosperity.

timelineBlueprints.title: Surya Pooja & Offerings
timelineBlueprints.description: Offering the first batch of Pongal to the Sun.

timelineBlueprints.title: Traditional Festival Lunch
timelineBlueprints.description: Serving Pongal and lunch to all participants.

timelineBlueprints.title: Uriadi and Cultural Games
timelineBlueprints.description: Traditional sports and fun group activities.
